visual_action: A slideshow of two photographs featuring Kamala Harris and Douglas Emhoff. In the first photo, they stand side-by-side holding hands and smiling at the camera, dressed in formal evening wear. In the second photo, taken from a side angle at the bottom of a staircase, Emhoff holds Harris's hand as she descends, and they look at each other and smile. A white heart emoji is superimposed on the second image.
